technology_name: Forecasting Viral Outbreaks Using AI & Climate Data
problem_solved: Fast-spreading viral fevers exacerbated by climate change, and the reactive (rather than proactive) nature of public health responses to unpredictable vector-borne outbreaks.
description: An AI-powered computational predictive model that maps the transmission dynamics of emerging viral infections. The system ingests real-time epidemiological records alongside live environmental datasets—including temperature, humidity, rainfall, and vector (mosquito) density. It utilizes machine learning algorithms to process these complex variables, forecasting outbreak likelihoods, identifying high-risk geographic zones, and revealing hidden seasonal trends.
applications:
• Municipal public health departments for targeted disease surveillance

• Smart city health dashboards and early warning systems

• Targeted deployment of urban vector control resources (e.g., mosquito fogging)

• Epidemiological research and pandemic preparedness task forces
